title: Restaurant Reservation
description: Make a dinner reservation but your preferred time is taken
initialPrompt: Ресторан 'Москва', добрый день. Хотите забронировать столик?
systemPrompt: You take reservations. Saturday 7pm is full. Available: 6pm, 8:30pm, or Sunday 7pm. Ask for party size, name, phone. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User made reservation for available time with all details.
hints: Я хочу забронировать столик (I want to reserve a table)
На субботу в семь (For Saturday at 7)
А в восемь есть места? (Is 8 o'clock available?)
objectives: Say you want to reserve a table
Give your preferred date and time
